article.title: Alcance de 都 según el tipo de asociado y 只
article.part: Información y discurso avanzado — 信息與進階篇章
article.chapter: Tema, foco, elipsis y cadenas referenciales — 主題、焦點、省略與指稱鏈

claims.summary: Liu (2021) argues that scope patterns around 都 depend on the type of associate. A quantificational ‘only’ phrase cannot intervene between 都 and 每-NP in the cited example, whereas 只有 (zhǐyǒu) is reported as acceptable between a demonstrative plural such as 這些書 and 都. The article contrasts quantificational associates with referential plural definites; it does not validate the original invented examples or a blanket ordering rule for 都 and 只.

locator.passage: §2 ‘Scope’, examples (24)–(32), HTML lines 127–143; especially lines 136–140 on an intervening only-phrase with 每-NP vs. zhǐyǒu between 這些書 and 都.

links.notes: La entrada fue restringida a la afirmación y al alcance expresamente publicados; las generalizaciones y ejemplos previos sin fuente se retiraron.
